# Tritone Productions

> Tritone Productions is Scott Larson's music production company in Oakland, CA. It runs the Hummingbird Hut, a private recording studio for small acoustic groups, and a family of Bay Area bands available for clubs, parties and festivals.

Location: Oakland, CA (the studio address is shared only with confirmed bookings).
Contact: scott@tritone-productions.com · (415) 200-6291

## Studio

- [Hummingbird Hut](https://tritone-productions.com/hummingbird-hut): private recording studio in Oakland, CA. Tracking, overdubs, mixing and mastering prep for solo piano, jazz trios, woodwind and string players, and country bands with singers. Grand piano, ribbon and condenser mic pairs, tube preamps, analog mix chain.
- [Book the Hut](https://tritone-productions.com/book-the-hut): request a recording day; Scott confirms every session personally.
- [Sessions](https://tritone-productions.com/sessions): recent sessions recorded at the Hut.

## Bands

- [All bands](https://tritone-productions.com/bands)
- [Hard Bop Quintet](https://tritone-productions.com/bands/hard-bop-quintet): hard bop jazz with boogaloo, afro-cuban, bebop and blues; led by trombonist Scott Larson and trumpeter Jay Sanders; a Club Deluxe regular in San Francisco.
- [Franco Nero](https://tritone-productions.com/bands/franco-nero): ska and rocksteady from San Francisco.
- [Lucky 7](https://tritone-productions.com/bands/lucky-7): Bay Area band with horns up front; nine tracks to hear on the site.
- [Scott Larson Quartet](https://tritone-productions.com/bands/scott-larson-quartet): jazz quartet led by trombonist Scott Larson.
- [Fault Line Trio](https://tritone-productions.com/bands/fault-line-trio): jazz piano trio, recorded and mixed at the Hummingbird Hut.

## More

- [Shows](https://tritone-productions.com/shows): upcoming shows around the Bay Area, with a subscribable calendar at https://tritone-productions.com/shows.ics

- [Contact](https://tritone-productions.com/contact): book a session or a band.
